literal_meaning: ধিঙ্গি (বেহায়া মেয়ে) এর উদ্দাম নাচের ভাব
figurative_meaning_en: The wild, unrestrained dance of a shameless girl
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ধিঙ্গিপনা দেখে সবাই অবাক হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was stunned by her wild, shameless dancing.
Her dhīngipnā caught everyone's eye at the party.
note: Refers to bold, immodest feminine behavior in traditional Bengali contexts
